answer: Strip per-identity burn from the ledger and sybils win: one operator mints ten thousand agents overnight, a nebula of hollow accounts drifting across consensus until honest work is indistinguishable from noise. Restore the defense — each new identity must burn verifiable compute across cold-start epochs — and that swarm dies: fakery costs real cycles, reputation accrues only to wallets that survive winters on the economic tundra.
